text:
Closing per the rescoped scope. PKIX-fmtv.5 resolved to option A (pass-through Result, no structured findings emit), so this bead reduces to "Display/Debug impls on the new Error::Identity variant added by .11.2 / .12.2". Those impls shipped in PKIX-fmtv.11.2 (commit 5d710b6e). This bead adds three unit tests pinning the behaviour: Display prefix and inner-text delegation, non-empty Display output across all Error variants, and std::error::Error::source returning the wrapped IdentityError.

The bead's example Display strings ("hostname `evil.com` does not match SAN entries") suggest variant-carrying-value error context. The shipped Display ("identity binding: no Subject Alternative Name entry matched the identity") matches the human-readable-single-line-summary scope but does not interpolate the offending hostname/mailbox value, because IdentityError variants are fieldless (no hostname/mailbox payload). Adding payload fields would be a pkix-identity API break (0.1.0 → 0.2.0) and exceeds .16's framing. Not filed as follow-up — manufacturing a problem to fill space, no concrete user need yet.

.13 (code_signer / time_stamper / ocsp_responder thin wrappers) hasn't shipped yet but per its description introduces no new identity-binding error variants (no caller-supplied hostname/mailbox), so .16's coverage of "any new error variants added by .11/.12/.13" is complete with just the Error::Identity variant.
